# codexbox v1.0.21

## Changed

- Sync the model price fallback with official OpenAI prices verified on September 30, 2026, including gpt-6.1-sol at $2 per million uncached input tokens.
- Refresh model prices from official OpenAI model pages automatically. Apply updated prices to new savings only; retain previously recorded historical amounts.
- Add a manual typed-decision panel and overview metrics for TypeSafe Jev and compatible model providers, including DeepSeek and custom endpoints.
- Save the TypeSafe official API key in the macOS Keychain and restore it after restarting the app. Evaluation requires explicit consent before sending text.
- Rename the desktop application to codexbox.
- Focus client connections and managed integrations on Codex. Other coding clients are no longer offered or automatically configured.
- Retain the existing application identity and local data directories for upgrade continuity. Existing configuration files belonging to other applications are not deleted.

## Fixed

- Keep forward price adjustments in UTC daily history buckets and local hourly buckets, preserving the existing history contract.

- Keep the dashboard responsive when Serena statistics are unavailable.
- Avoid filesystem enumeration for Serena dashboard discovery, so an unavailable network mount cannot block startup.
- Bound listener identity queries and prevent overlapping runtime checks when opening the window.

## Compatibility

- macOS is the stable desktop target; Windows 11 x64 remains a preview.
- The project remains an unofficial derivative of open-source Headroom components and is not affiliated with OpenAI.
